verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents an archive task that creates ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ and TAR.BZ2 archives, and jobs chain import, convert and export tasks, so repacking can happen within a conversion pipeline. Nothing in the evidence shows extracting or unpacking incoming archives, which is half the story. Missing for 10: documented extraction of ZIP/7z/RAR inputs, an evidenced extract-convert-repack workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
